title: Hardware Test Result
description: Per-run result for a single lever (baseline or optid). One hwtest-result.json per lever per bundle. Contains the power source, sample counts, per-phase per-metric measurements, and anomaly flags.

lever.description: Which lever this result is for. 'baseline' = mainstream defaults (PPD balanced); 'optid' = optid --apply.

power_source.description: The power source during this run. 'battery' runs must have power_source=battery; 'ac' runs must have power_source=ac. The validator cross-checks this against the run's battery_pct and AC-online status.

name.description: Phase name (must match a phase in the plan).

observed_class.description: The class optid actually resolved to. Must match expected_class (no class_mismatch).

samples.description: Raw sample values. Length must equal n.

n.description: Number of samples. Must be >= plan.min_samples (no insufficient_n).

battery_pct.description: Battery percentage at run end (null for desktop slots or AC runs).

ac_online.description: Whether AC was online during the run (null for battery-only devices).

energy_joules.description: Total energy consumed during the run in joules (for Criterion 3 battery comparison).

anomalies.description: Anomaly flags (e.g. 'insufficient_n', 'class_mismatch', 'unsupported_here'). The validator rejects evidence with 'insufficient_n' or 'class_mismatch'.
